entry_points.text: Init matches configured name against table rejecting unknown, runs type setup, records params, arms shutdown, normalizes counts with warnings, allocates readers and starts reader plus coordinator threads with common cleanup on failure.
Tiny IRQ work recovers instance and schedules grace work; per-CPU delay timer recovers record and queues it same-CPU; SRCU IRQ work samples delay under IRQ-saved lock and queues delayed grace work.

Tiny sync advances control sequence twice outside read sections under preemption guard; tree sync warns in read sections, uses expedited or normal when blocking allowed else early-boot vacuous advance; cookie orders prior updates, starter ensures progress and wakes thread only on need.
Stall notifier helper forwards event value and pointer to CPU stall atomic chain and returns result.

exports.text: Cleanup serializes against reentry, is no-op without selected impl, stops reader threads, frees reader storage, stops coordinator and runs impl teardown.
Expedited wait forbids read-side use and never from atomic, completes vacuously when blocking implies quiescence, falls back when disabled, else coalesces, sleeps on snapshot then releases guard.

hazards.text: Stall panic offers mask to scheduler for recovery, counts and panics only past threshold when enabled; flavor checker warns on NMI-unsafe in NMI, multi-bit and CPU or structure mismatches installing first CPU flavor atomically; leak callback drops without reclaim.

invariants.text: Scheduler-start flag is widely visible; boot SRCU init marks done then unlinks each boot-list instance and schedules its grace-period work.
Tree constructors record normal, fast or fast-updown flavor before common setup that checks no locks held and inits fields in non-sleepable context.
Index emptiness compares unlock sums taken first against lock sums, warns on mixed flavors, uses barrier or RCU sync so equality implies momentary emptiness within bounds.
Expedited sequence is monotonic with snapshot, active and done plus polled snapshot; start and end advance together with barriers ordering stores and completion checks.
Leaf selection excuses local and not-in-next-init CPUs, classifies rest by watching snapshot with recheck for idle or migration, signals remainder with hotplug retry.
Expedited stall interval falls back to normal interval when tunable is zero, clamps to 2 ticks to 300s with writeback plus debug pad; normal clamps seconds 3 to 300 then scales by HZ plus delta.
SRCU lock samples counter-set pointer, bumps CPU lock count with ordering and returns index; unlock orders then bumps unlock count; flip publishes alternate set with full barriers.

Grace end uses zero delay if expedited else one tick, completes sequence, raises need, refreshes lagging per-CPU needed against wrap, schedules boot CPU when small else BFS nodes collecting have-CB masks, drives size growth unless small or big; records hold sequences, mutexes, size state, barrier and per-CPU work.

Reschedule idles without queueing when satisfied, warns if active while satisfied, starts idle period on request then queues delayed work; worker advances state and budgets same-jiffy reschedules before forcing one tick.
Quiet check samples delay need then polls reader counts with microsecond sleeps until tries plus no-delay exhausted; barrier callback self-links, decrements count and completes on last arrival.

locks.text: Tiny unlock holds preemption across nest decrement, restores it, and wakes one waiter only when count hits zero with grace waiter and sleepable context.

Tree mutation holds IRQ-disabled raw node locks for masks, task capture, hotplug, selection and completion; per-node spin guards publish desires, global mutex allows one period, wake mutex publishes completion.

Grace end holds callback mutex across completion and scheduling to overlap at most one extra period, uses usage lock for sequence updates, drops grace mutex before scheduling then conditionally restarts.

Callback invocation advances segmented list under per-CPU lock with invoking flag excluding concurrency, drops lock during invocation under BH protection, then adjusts length and reschedules if more ready.

state_machines.text: Tiny worker exits if running or no work, else marks running, detaches callbacks under IRQ guard, flips index and arms waiting, polls with bounded sleeps for old readers, flips again, invokes callbacks under BH guard, clears running and requeues if more work.

Normal sync traces, fast-waits when wakeups disabled or latched else enqueues with completion, kicks poller and waits; latch bumps counter before visible with only threshold updater setting flag for path only; polled start opens seq when idle and snapshots, end completes on match else zeroes; root uses IRQ-saving lock only after init publishes CPUs.

Expedited coalesces via per-node desired and global guard with followers sleeping on covered snaps; prep adopts pending hotplug sets propagating only newly non-empty leaves and anchors blocked tails when config reports readers; selection runs inline early-boot else on workers with flush; completion publishes under wake guard advancing desires, waking queues and running no-CB wakes.
Blocking wait tries bounded sleep, on full dynticks arms tick deps then retries, then loops collecting laggards, emitting state while not suppressed, backing off interval and applying panic policy.

SRCU advance under grace mutex moves idle to first to second scan; idle starts when requested exceeds current, first needs one quiet then flips, second needs two quiets then ends; busy returns for retry.
Per-CPU expedited callback state under lock treats idle as unexpected, moves pending to idle, and moves repost to pending with requeue as expedited after unlock.

structs.text: Tiny SRCU fields include two nesting counters, wait queue, callback queue with tail at head, running and waiting flags, index and max index, plus deferred and IRQ work for grace driving.

Holdoff default 25000 with mutable control and wrap threshold ULONG_MAX right-shifted by two; sizing none 0 init 1 torture 2 auto 3 default contend 16 with combined tests; big 128 small 100, node seq 2, log rcu colon space; leaf bit is CPU minus group low.

SRCU timing defaults are 5us retry, 1 tick base, 10 ticks max, phase no-delay low 3 high 1000 with 2s ticks adjusted default clamped between them and total lower-bounded by 100, plus mutable currents and clamp helpers.
